latest.title: A Complex Structure on A Rational Homology Six-Sphere with Two-Torsion
latest.abstract: We construct a compact, smooth, simply connected complex threefold. Its second and third integral homology groups are cyclic of order two, and its remaining homology groups agree with those of the six-sphere.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 构造紧单连通复三维流形，其二、三阶整数同调为 Z₂，其余同调与六球相同。
techniques: 整数同调与基本群计算
latest.breakthrough: 给出带二阶挠元的有理同调六球复结构。
latest.limitations: 不是 S⁶ 上的复结构；有理同调球不等于整数同调球。 已补读引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.aiEvidence: GPT-5.6 Sol 用于计算，GPT-6 Astra 用于语法和表述。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.11541v1 — Statement on the use of AI
latest.priorityReason: 复结构与拓扑约束的边界值得关注，勿与六球问题混淆。
